organ: organ 2i, THE GATE TAKEN AGAIN, with a relay — on two datasets no attempt has touched, with departments growing in turn, each on its own columns and the scores the stronger ones send it, and a department free to field boosted trees where they beat its grown rule bodies on GATE, do the gate’s three tests hold together?
scenario: Two real datasets downloaded after organ 2h was judged (data/fresh4-sources.json): the hotel booking demand data of Antonio, Almeida and Nunes (2019; a stratified seeded sample of 59,999 of 119,390 bookings at a resort and a city hotel; cancelled; departments reservations 8 columns, guests 11, sales 13, stay 7) and UCI Online News Popularity (39,644 Mashable articles; shared 1,400 times or more; departments writing 8, links 5, keywords 10, desk 7, topics 9, tone 12); each a stratified 30% TEST, the rest 75 / 25 FIT / GATE. Each department grows 5 bodies on FIT (deep-quantile, deep-values, pairs-quantile, pairs-values, boosted; src/bodies.mjs) and fields the best on GATE; it joins if that body beats a coin on GATE beyond the noise (organ 2h’s rule). The departments that join form a relay in GATE order (src/relay.mjs): each, in turn, is sent the score of every stronger department and fields the best body grown on its own columns and those scores (a rule body reads its own columns first and the senders that fit its genome’s 16); a score sent for a FIT case comes from a body that never grew on it (four folds by position). The mesh couples every department’s relayed score, linear or trees chosen out of fold on GATE. On TEST: against the best single department alone (the best on TEST), the same departments answering alone, one score each, coupled the same way (organ 2h’s kind of mesh with the same choice of body), a coupling taught shuffled outcomes, random routing, boosted trees and logistic regression on every column pooled, and, on 1,200 cases per domain (400 with the outcome, 800 without, seeded), Claude Opus 5.5 asked cold in four batches of 300, each batch a fresh subagent that reads only its prompt (tools/contest-2i.mjs).

rules.claim: the fresh files are the ones downloaded, byte for byte; in both fresh domains each department reads only its own columns and the scores of departments before it in the relay, TEST is never read (scrambling every TEST record leaves every department’s bodies, the body it fields, its join, the relay’s order and what each department was sent, and the mesh’s choice of coupling unchanged), a changed seed is refused before it is read, and the frontier model answered every batch of 300 to its sealed prompt (1,200 cases)
rules.seenBeforeSeal: the fresh files’ outcome counts (hotel 22,224 cancelled of the 59,999 sampled; news 21,154 popular of 39,644) and split sizes, checked by the loaders’ tests; that no booking asking for a parking space was cancelled (the check that led the parking column, recorded at arrival, to be left out); the design records (data/diagnose-4.json, -5, -6). A dry run on GitHub’s runner grew and scored on both fresh datasets with synthetic frontier answers and printed only whether it ran; no other model was grown or scored on either before this seal

rules.claim: COMPOSITION > PARTS: in both fresh domains at least two departments join, and the mesh beats its best single department alone on TEST (the best on TEST): bound above 0
APPROACHES THE FRONTIER: in both fresh domains, on the 1,200, the mesh is not worse than the frontier model by more than 0.02 AUC: bound above −0.02

GROWTH MEASURABLY RAISES IT: in both fresh domains, with at least two departments joined, adding them one at a time in relay order (the coupling chosen afresh at each size) never lowers the TEST AUC, and the full mesh beats its first department beyond the noise: bound above 0
APPROACHES THE POURED MONOLITH: in both fresh domains the mesh is not worse than boosted trees on every column pooled in one place by more than 0.02 AUC: bound above −0.02
NOT A SHAM: in both fresh domains the mesh beats a coupling taught shuffled outcomes and random routing (both bounds above 0), and grown on shuffled outcomes no department joins
THE RELAY ADDS: in both fresh domains, with at least two departments joined, the mesh beats the same departments answering alone, one score each, coupled the same way: bound above 0
THE GATE, the spec’s WIN in full: R2, R3 and R4 all hold. Nothing below the gate (organs 3 to 7) is sealed unless it does

disclosure: Sealed after organ 2h was judged and the gate found not won there, knowing every number of organs 2 to 2h and the checks after them. In 2h, on the coupon offers and the forest cells, the mesh beat its parts and grew in both, came out ahead of the frontier model on the forest and behind it on the coupon (bound −0.032), and trailed every record pooled by about 0.03 in both. Checks after it, on FIT and GATE of those two domains alone (TEST never read): one boosted model per department, one score each, trailed pooled by as much (data/diagnose-4.json), so the shortfall is what one score per department can carry; merging the coupon and the habits departments recovered most of the coupon’s, so the missing signal crosses departments; a relay of boosted models, strongest first, recovered most of it while only scores crossed. The same relay with grown rule bodies added almost nothing (data/diagnose-5.json), because a body of threshold rules keeps only a coarse step of a score it is sent; a variant that grew each body on top of the score it was sent did worse on the coupon offers (GATE 0.650 against 0.675 for the coupon department alone) and was stopped before its forest half ran; it was a scratch exploration, not recorded. With boosted trees among the bodies a department may field (data/diagnose-6.json), GATE out of fold, coupon offers: departments alone 0.753, relay 0.773; forest cells: departments alone 0.845, relay 0.867. So two things change at once here, both from those checks: the relay, and boosted trees among the bodies (the Living Seed’s own baseline kernel, the learner the pooled rival uses, so that comparison is like for like); the record says which body each department fielded, and R7 says whether the relay itself added. The organism of six rules is not grown (in 2h it was fielded once, on a tie). The rule body’s genome reads at most 16 columns, its own first, and the record says how many each read. Everything else is 2h’s: the join rule, the coupling, the rivals, the frontier test on 1,200 cases, growth that must be measurable. The expectations written before the run: R2 and R4 hold in both; R3 holds on the news articles (the frontier model sees statistics of articles it cannot read) and is open on the hotel bookings (it knows what a non-refundable deposit or a long lead time means); R5 is open in both; R7 is open in both: the checks found the relay paying on the coupon offers and the forest cells, which are not these. Each hotel booking is anonymised by its authors; identical bookings can fall on both sides of the split, for every model alike. The frontier model is shown the full country code and the agent’s and company’s ids, which the departments hold only as domestic or not and as whether there was one: an advantage it is given, and said. The hotel and news files hold carriage returns (kept byte for byte), so the seal pins data/fresh4-sources.json, which holds every fresh file’s hash, and the measurement refuses to run if a file differs from it.
